purpose: Verify normal ended-call denial, server timer enforcement during a locally failed backend end operation, and delayed-first-join/empty-session deadline reset behavior. This is not approval of a release duration or bounded-risk security policy.
call_id_source: Three fresh UUIDs returned by authenticated creation RPCs in a disposable local schema-only database; persisted before provider mutation. Never replace an unsuccessful call with another ID.

calls.name: normal_end
calls.end: Actual authenticated end RPC, durable worker, Stream end acknowledgement

calls.name: active_timer_with_end_failure
calls.end: Local end-port exception before HTTP; observe provider timer before recovering end worker

calls.name: delayed_join_empty_session_restart
calls.end: Local end-port exception before HTTP; close both media peers, observe inactivity, try held-token rejoin and compare original and new deadlines; recover worker

inherit_existing_policy: VOICE consent and acceptance required in disposable DB
No video, screen sharing, recording, transcription or broadcasting
permitted_fixture_operations: Preflight exact app identity, authentication/permission checks and approved call-type grants
Abort if any of the three named provider identities already exists; upsert only those absent identities
Create/get/update members of only the three owned calls using the existing actual worker and adapter
Set ring=false and notify=false on fixture call creation
Generate ordinary short-lived user JWTs for these owned participants only; retain credentials inside the Deno process
Join known fixture calls, publish/subscribe synthetic audio, record signaling and sender/receiver RTP counters

Using ordinary JWTs, attempt extension to 120 seconds, timer disabling with 0, and recreation of the same ended ID; all must be denied or leave the call ended. These are adversarial permission checks, not server-authorized timer extensions
After end, compare held-token validity with separately minted valid ordinary JWTs; this does not authorize the application to issue credentials to revoked users
Feed a previously observed session through the real reconcile RPC in the disposable DB to test late ACTIVE evidence
Recover actual end jobs, then end/hard-delete the three exact calls and hard-delete only the three owned identities
bounded_diagnostics: At most three media attempts on the same call if subscriber diagnostics require a local correction. No replacement calls, extra identities, call-type writes or server-authorized timer extensions. Persist partial evidence and clean up on failure.
failure_injection: Only the adapter's end operation throws before the SDK/HTTP request. Other provider reads, ordinary joins, SFU signaling and media remain live. This is not a real Stream outage or network firewall test.
cleanup_verification: Zero owned users; each owned call returns 404/code 16; full call-type digest equals the read-only baseline; remove disposable database and REST container
exclusions: No role or call-type definition writes
No global or Live settings writes
No existing user or call mutations
No deployments, builds or OTA updates
No real calling or M2B/M3 enablement
readiness: M2A and M2B stay BLOCKED pending explicit acceptance and independent verification of any revised security policy
execution_outcome: Normal end/rejoin control completed; active timer marked ended but audio delivery continued; empty-session SFU reconnect failed and remaining restart checks are inconclusive
